mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate strong consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising at least 0.5% over 3 months), higher interest rates reduce corporate leverage and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1200 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 1200 for two months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in industrial production and GDP indicates robust supply-side expansion that supports corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through improved economic momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market slack suppresses wage growth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
